name: Raikot Bridge
facts: Raikot Bridge, a key gateway to Nanga Parbat base camp, spans the mighty River Indus on the Karakoram Highway, linking Pakistan’s high‑altitude frontier to the rest of the world.

Between 2008 and 2013, the KKH Upgrade Project widened the 335‑km Raikot‑Khunjerab stretch from 10 to 30 meters, adding 32 new bridges and rehabilitating 27, ensuring year‑round traffic for heavy vehicles.

The $491 million upgrade, funded by China Eximbank and Pakistan, culminated on November 30, 2013, with the bridge meeting China’s three‑level highway standard, a testament to international engineering collaboration.
